passages.text: At the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet in Judah.
Josiah was king of Judah.
Jehoiakim was Josiah’s son.
Jehoiakim became king of Judah.
At the beginning of Jehoiakim’s reign, the LORD spoke to Jeremiah.
The LORD gave Jeremiah a message.
passages.original: בְּרֵאשִׁ֗ית מַמְלֶ֛כֶת יְהוֹיָקִ֥ם בֶּן־ יֹאושִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הָיָ֞ה הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֔ה מֵאֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃

passages.text: This is what the LORD said to me: “Make for yourself a yoke out of leather straps and put it on your neck.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
The LORD gave me a command.
The LORD told me to make a yoke.
The LORD told me to use leather straps for the yoke.
The LORD told me to put the yoke on my neck.
passages.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י עֲשֵׂ֣ה לְךָ֔ מוֹסֵר֖וֹת וּמֹט֑וֹת וּנְתַתָּ֖ם עַל־ צַוָּארֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Send word to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon through the envoys who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jeremiah at the beginning of Zedekiah’s reign.
Zedekiah was the son of Josiah.
Zedekiah was king of Judah.
God told Jeremiah to send a message.
Jeremiah must send this message to five kings.
These kings are the king of Edom, the king of Moab, the king of Ammon, the king of Tyre, and the king of Sidon.
Envoys from these nations came to Jerusalem.
These envoys came to Zedekiah, king of Judah.
Jeremiah must give the message to these envoys.
The envoys will take the message to their kings.
passages.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתָּם֩ אֶל־ מֶ֨לֶךְ אֱד֜וֹם וְאֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֗ב וְאֶל־ מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וְאֶל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ צֹ֖ר וְאֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ צִיד֑וֹן בְּיַ֤ד מַלְאָכִים֙ הַבָּאִ֣ים יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֶל־ צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: Give them a message from the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, to relay to their masters: By My great power and outstretched arm, I made the earth and the men and beasts on the face of it, and I give it to whom I please.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
The LORD of Hosts gave a message.
The LORD of Hosts told you to give this message to their masters.
The LORD of Hosts said this:
I made the earth.
I made the people on the earth.
I made the animals on the earth.
I used My great power to do this.
I used My outstretched arm to do this.
I give the earth to anyone I choose.
passages.original: וְצִוִּיתָ֣ אֹתָ֔ם אֶל־ אֲדֹֽנֵיהֶ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֥ה תֹֽאמְר֖וּ אֶל־ אֲדֹֽנֵיכֶֽם׃ אָנֹכִ֞י עָשִׂ֣יתִי אֶת־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֶת־ הָאָדָ֤ם וְאֶת־ הַבְּהֵמָה֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּכֹחִי֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל וּבִזְרוֹעִ֖י הַנְּטוּיָ֑ה וּנְתַתִּ֕יהָ לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר יָשַׁ֥ר בְּעֵינָֽי׃

passages.text: So now I have placed all these lands under the authority of My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. I have even made the beasts of the field subject to him.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking.
God has power over all lands.
God has given all these lands to Nebuchadnezzar.
Nebuchadnezzar is king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar is God's servant.
God has also given the wild animals to Nebuchadnezzar.
The wild animals must serve Nebuchadnezzar.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ נָתַ֙תִּי֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאֲרָצ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה בְּיַ֛ד נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל עַבְדִּ֑י וְגַם֙ אֶת־ חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה נָתַ֥תִּי ל֖וֹ לְעָבְדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: All nations will serve him and his son and grandson, until the time of his own land comes; then many nations and great kings will enslave him.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking.
God is the LORD of Hosts.
God is the God of Israel.
God gave a message to the people.
God said all nations will serve Nebuchadnezzar.
Nebuchadnezzar is the king of Babylon.
All nations will also serve Nebuchadnezzar’s son.
All nations will also serve Nebuchadnezzar’s grandson.
This will continue until Nebuchadnezzar’s own time of judgment comes.
After that, many nations will make Nebuchadnezzar’s land serve them.
Many great kings will rule over Nebuchadnezzar’s land.
passages.original: וְעָבְד֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְאֶת־ בְּנ֖וֹ וְאֶֽת־ בֶּן־ בְּנ֑וֹ עַ֣ד בֹּא־ עֵ֤ת אַרְצוֹ֙ גַּם־ ה֔וּא וְעָ֤בְדוּ בוֹ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וּמְלָכִ֖ים גְּדֹלִֽים׃

passages.text: As for the nation or kingdom that does not serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and does not place its neck under his yoke, I will punish that nation by sword and famine and plague, declares the LORD, until I have destroyed it by his hand.
passages.sermon:
God speaks with authority.
God calls Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon His servant.
God gives Nebuchadnezzar power over many nations and kingdoms.
If any nation or kingdom refuses to serve Nebuchadnezzar,
If any nation or kingdom does not submit to Nebuchadnezzar’s rule,
God will punish that nation.
God will punish them with the sword.
God will punish them with famine.
God will punish them with plague.
The LORD Himself declares this.
God will continue to punish that nation until He destroys it.
God will destroy that nation by Nebuchadnezzar’s hand.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֨ה הַגּ֜וֹי וְהַמַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ יַעַבְד֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ אֶת־ נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֔ל וְאֵ֨ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ יִתֵּן֙ אֶת־ צַוָּאר֔וֹ בְּעֹ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל בַּחֶרֶב֩ וּבָרָעָ֨ב וּבַדֶּ֜בֶר אֶפְקֹ֨ד עַל־ הַגּ֤וֹי הַהוּא֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה עַד־ תֻּמִּ֥י אֹתָ֖ם בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But as for you, do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your interpreters of dreams, your mediums, or your sorcerers who declare, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon.’
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Judah.
God warned them about false leaders.
Do not listen to your prophets.
Do not listen to your diviners.
Do not listen to those who interpret your dreams.
Do not listen to your mediums.
Do not listen to your sorcerers.
These people say to you, “You will not serve the king of Babylon.”
Do not believe them.
passages.original: וְ֠אַתֶּם אַל־ תִּשְׁמְע֨וּ אֶל־ נְבִיאֵיכֶ֜ם וְאֶל־ קֹֽסְמֵיכֶ֗ם וְאֶל֙ חֲלֹמֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֶל־ עֹֽנְנֵיכֶ֖ם וְאֶל־ כַּשָּׁפֵיכֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֞ם אֹמְרִ֤ים אֲלֵיכֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תַעַבְד֖וּ אֶת־ מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃

passages.text: For they prophesy to you a lie that will serve to remove you from your land; I will banish you and you will perish.
passages.sermon:
The prophets and diviners speak to you.
They tell you things that are not true.
They prophesy lies to you.
Their lies will cause you to leave your land.
I, the LORD, will drive you away from your land.
You will perish.
passages.original: כִּ֣י שֶׁ֔קֶר הֵ֖ם נִבְּאִ֣ים לָכֶ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן הַרְחִ֤יק אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵעַ֣ל אַדְמַתְכֶ֔ם וְהִדַּחְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם וַאֲבַדְתֶּֽם׃

passages.text: But the nation that will put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will leave in its own land, to cultivate it and reside in it, declares the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD makes a promise.
A nation may choose to serve the king of Babylon.
This nation must submit to the king of Babylon.
This nation must obey and serve him.
The LORD will allow this nation to remain in its own land.
The people of this nation will work their land.
The people of this nation will live in their land.
passages.original: וְהַגּ֗וֹי אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבִ֧יא אֶת־ צַוָּאר֛וֹ בְּעֹ֥ל מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל וַֽעֲבָד֑וֹ וְהִנַּחְתִּ֤יו עַל־ אַדְמָתוֹ֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וַֽעֲבָדָ֖הּ וְיָ֥שַׁב בָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: And to Zedekiah king of Judah I spoke the same message: “Put your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon; serve him and his people, and live!
passages.sermon:
Zedekiah was the king of Judah.
I spoke to Zedekiah.
I gave him the same message as before.
I said, "Put your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon.
Serve the king of Babylon and his people.
If you do this, you will live."
passages.original: וְאֶל־ צִדְקִיָּ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי כְּכָל־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לֵאמֹ֑ר הָבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־ צַוְּארֵיכֶ֜ם בְּעֹ֣ל מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֗ל וְעִבְד֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ וְעַמּ֖וֹ וִֽחְיֽוּ׃

passages.text: Why should you and your people die by sword and famine and plague, as the LORD has decreed against any nation that does not serve the king of Babylon?
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Zedekiah, king of Judah.
God warned Zedekiah and his people.
God said, “If you do not serve the king of Babylon, you will die.
You and your people will die by the sword.
You and your people will die by famine.
You and your people will die by plague.
The LORD has decreed this punishment.
The LORD will punish any nation that does not serve the king of Babylon.”
passages.original: לָ֤מָּה תָמ֙וּתוּ֙ אַתָּ֣ה וְעַמֶּ֔ךָ בַּחֶ֖רֶב בָּרָעָ֣ב וּבַדָּ֑בֶר֙ כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ הַגּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃

passages.text: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who say, ‘You must not serve the king of Babylon,’ for they are prophesying to you a lie.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to the people of Judah.
He warned them about false prophets.
Some prophets say, “You must not serve the king of Babylon.”
Do not listen to these prophets.
They are telling you lies.
They are not speaking the truth from God.
passages.original: וְאַֽל־ תִּשְׁמְע֞וּ אֶל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַנְּבִאִ֗ים הָאֹמְרִ֤ים אֲלֵיכֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תַעַבְד֖וּ אֶת־ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל כִּ֣י שֶׁ֔קֶר הֵ֖ם נִבְּאִ֥ים לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: For I have not sent them, declares the LORD, and yet they are prophesying falsely in My name; therefore I will banish you, and you will perish—you and the prophets who prophesy to you.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD says, "I have not sent these prophets."
These prophets claim to speak in the LORD's name.
They prophesy lies.
They do this to lead you astray.
Because of this, I will drive you away.
You will perish.
The prophets who prophesy to you will also perish.
passages.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א שְׁלַחְתִּים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְהֵ֛ם נִבְּאִ֥ים בִּשְׁמִ֖י לַשָּׁ֑קֶר לְמַ֨עַן הַדִּיחִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֔ם אַתֶּ֕ם וְהַנְּבִאִ֖ים הַֽנִּבְּאִ֥ים לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then I said to the priests and to all this people, “This is what the LORD says: Do not listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, ‘Look, very soon now the articles from the house of the LORD will be brought back from Babylon.’ They are prophesying to you a lie.
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah spoke to the priests and to all the people.
He said, “This is what the LORD says.
Do not listen to your prophets.
These prophets speak to you.
They say, ‘Soon the articles from the house of the LORD will return from Babylon.’
They are lying to you.
They do not speak the truth.
passages.original: וְאֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִים֩ וְאֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֨ם הַזֶּ֜ה דִּבַּ֣רְתִּי לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒ אַֽל־ תִּשְׁמְע֞וּ אֶל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י נְבִֽיאֵיכֶ֗ם הַֽנִּבְּאִ֤ים לָכֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֨ה כְלֵ֧י בֵית־ יְהוָ֛ה מוּשָׁבִ֥ים מִבָּבֶ֖לָה עַתָּ֣ה מְהֵרָ֑ה כִּ֣י שֶׁ֔קֶר הֵ֖מָּה נִבְּאִ֥ים לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Do not listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon and live! Why should this city become a ruin?
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to the people of Jerusalem.
He warned them about false prophets.
He said, "Do not listen to these prophets."
They tell you lies.
Serve the king of Babylon.
If you serve him, you will live.
If you do not serve him, this city will become a ruin.
You will lose your home if you do not obey.
Obey the LORD’s command and live.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּשְׁמְע֣וּ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם עִבְד֥וּ אֶת־ מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל וִֽחְי֑וּ לָ֧מָּה תִֽהְיֶ֛ה הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את חָרְבָּֽה׃

passages.text: If they are indeed prophets and the word of the LORD is with them, let them now plead with the LORD of Hosts that the articles remaining in the house of the LORD, in the palace of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem, not be taken to Babylon.
passages.sermon:
The people claimed to be prophets.
They said they had the word of the LORD with them.
Let them pray to the LORD of Hosts now.
Let them ask God to keep the remaining articles safe.
These articles are in the house of the LORD, the palace of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
Let them pray that these articles will not be taken to Babylon.
passages.original: וְאִם־ נְבִאִ֣ים הֵ֔ם וְאִם־ יֵ֥שׁ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אִתָּ֑ם יִפְגְּעוּ־ נָא֙ בַּֽיהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לְבִלְתִּי־ בֹ֜אוּ הַכֵּלִ֣ים׀ הַנּוֹתָרִ֣ים בְּבֵית־ יְהוָ֗ה וּבֵ֨ית מֶ֧לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֛ה וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָה׃פ

passages.text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says about the pillars, the sea, the bases, and the rest of the articles that remain in this city, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take when he carried Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon, along with all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
The LORD of Hosts speaks about the objects in Jerusalem.
These objects include the pillars, the sea, the bases, and the other articles that still remain in this city.
Nebuchadnezzar is the king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar did not take these objects when he took people into exile.
He took Jeconiah, son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon.
He also took all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem into exile.
The remaining articles stayed in the city.
passages.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֶל־ הָֽעַמֻּדִ֔ים וְעַל־ הַיָּ֖ם וְעַל־ הַמְּכֹנ֑וֹת וְעַל֙ יֶ֣תֶר הַכֵּלִ֔ים הַנּוֹתָרִ֖ים בָּעִ֥יר הַזֹּֽאת׃ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ לְקָחָ֗ם נְבֽוּכַדְנֶאצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל בַּ֠גְלוֹתוֹ אֶת־ יְכָונְיָ֨ה בֶן־ יְהוֹיָקִ֧ים מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֛ה מִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶ֑לָה וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־ חֹרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

passages.text: Yes, this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says about the articles that remain in the house of the LORD, in the palace of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem: ‘They will be carried to Babylon and will remain there until the day I attend to them again,’ declares the LORD. ‘Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
He speaks about the articles that still remain.
These articles are in the house of the LORD.
Some are in the palace of the king of Judah.
Some are in Jerusalem.
The LORD says these articles will be carried to Babylon.
They will stay in Babylon.
They will remain there until the day the LORD attends to them again.
The LORD declares this.
On that day, the LORD will bring the articles back.
He will restore them to this place.
passages.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַל־ הַכֵּלִ֗ים הַנּֽוֹתָרִים֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וּבֵ֥ית מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ בָּבֶ֥לָה יוּבָ֖אוּ וְשָׁ֣מָּה יִֽהְי֑וּ עַ֠ד י֣וֹם פָּקְדִ֤י אֹתָם֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְהַֽעֲלִיתִים֙ וַהֲשִׁ֣יבֹתִ֔ים אֶל־ הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ
